name: voxtell-seg
description: Run VoxTell text-prompted and nnInteractive bbox-prompted 3-D medical image segmentation as callable tools, with request validation that refuses anatomically impossible prompts before any compute is spent.

voxtell_python.title: Python interpreter
voxtell_python.description: A Python that can import voxtell and torch. Leave as 'python' to use whatever is on PATH; give a full path if VoxTell lives in a specific environment (e.g. C:\\Users\\you\\miniconda3\\envs\\voxtell\\python.exe or /home/you/envs/voxtell/bin/python).

voxtell_model_dir.title: VoxTell checkpoint directory (optional)
voxtell_model_dir.description: Folder containing plans.json and fold_0/checkpoint_final.pth. Leave blank and the setup tool will download it from Hugging Face to ~/.cache/voxtell_models.

nninteractive_weights.title: nnInteractive weights directory (optional)
nninteractive_weights.description: Folder containing the nnInteractive_v1.0 checkpoint, which must include fold_all. Leave blank to disable nninteractive_segment.
